title: Tuxedo band and Louis Armstrong's departure
summary: Asked whether he joined the Tuxedo before or after Louis Armstrong, Happy says shortly after, and played jobs with him.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: Were you in the tuxedo before Louis Armstrong or after him?
Oh, no, I was in there. Short after. Short after. Yeah. Close up. I played a quite a few jobs. Mm-hmm. Yeah, I was with Louis. With that band?

Mm-hmm. Because when Louis was getting ready to go away, we, we, we, we, we, we had a big thing at the time. Mm-hmm. And we'd say, well, I'm gonna play this one. It's this one, and I don't think I'll play any more. And they pulled Sonny with arm down while I'm in my office. They take your arm down, Papa, to see how I got it. I don't wanna play this when the boy plays it.
